turns.input: $text $markdown Improve this prompt we use in ChatGPT at our Rotterdam warehouse: "Summarise today's exceptions for the next shift." Every evening the day shift lead pastes the exception log (damaged pallets, short picks, late trucks, scanner faults), and the night lead reads the summary at the 22:00 handover. It should group exceptions by type, flag anything still open, give the dock door and pallet ID for each open item and stay under 200 words. No blame language, just facts. Structure it with RCAF. No questions, use your judgment on anything I left open.
